Adverse Effects and Precautions Immediate hypersensitivity reactions, including urticaria, pruri- tus, hypotension, and syncope, can occur with abarelix, and the cumulative risk of such a reaction increases with repeated doses. Patients should be monitored for at least 30 minutes after each injection. Hot flushes, sleep disturbance, breast enlargement and tenderness may result from testosterone reduction.
